texture: flat matte ink
small hard-edged dots with no halo
deep unbroken black ground
contrast: tiny white points against a field that swallows most of the frame
vertical and horizontal pitch are equal, so the lattice reads the same across and down
five rows and ten columns spaced identically, no variation anywhere
images.focal: The eye lands on one dot then jumps along the row, with the black field between holding no detail.
images.balance: Every dot is isolated and the frame rests across the wide black intervals in all directions.

text: a study in typography & pattern design
images.composition: Flat-on portrait sheet, no symmetry, one diagonal pile-up of overlapping letterforms weighted right.
texture: engraved hairline ruling packed inside the curved strokes
flat matte paper ground
solid inky wedges with no tonal break
printed dot fill at two different gauges
contrast: hairline striping against unbroken black wedges
the ground's fine dot grid answered at ten times the scale by the dotted fill inside the lens shape
each heavy stroke shadowed by a thin ghost outline of the same curve
two hairline diagonals cross the sheet at matching angles, one upper left, one lower right
images.focal: The eye lands on the large striped swash at centre right and follows its loop up into the ascending bowl.
images.balance: The left two thirds carry nothing but dot grid; every drawn form crowds the right edge and the bottom right corner.

images.composition: Overhead vantage looking down at the held sheet, which sits on a slight tilt and cuts diagonally across a horizontally banded ground.
texture: mirror-bright foil that goes from white glare to grey as the sheet bows
brushed slat faces holding a soft linear sheen
matte skin against the reflective sheet
sprayed and flicked ink speckle over the pattern field
sheer dotted hosiery breaking the leg into halftone
contrast: one orange dress against silver, black and steel blue everywhere else
the flat repeating damask field against the loose brush circle drawn over it
the slat rhythm behind and the tight lace repeat on the cover run at the same insistent beat
the sheet's curl catches light on the left edge and drops to shadow on the right
images.focal: The orange dress at the centre of the sheet, held there by the seated figure's face just above it.
images.balance: The middle of the frame is packed from the wrists up through the cover; the slats fill the top corners and the far right with an even, empty rhythm.

subjects: dark sphere set in the O
images.composition: Centred horizontal lockup on a full-bleed gradient, with a broad diagonal light band running lower left to upper right.
texture: heavy film grain laid evenly across the whole field
airbrushed gradient with no hard edge anywhere in the ground
glassy convex bead inside the O, the one specular thing in frame
letter edges bloomed and soft, as if lit from behind
contrast: a chartreuse wash top left meeting crimson down the right
the indigo corner bottom left as the only dark weight
the letters take their greens and reds straight from the ground behind them rather than opposing it
the sphere in the O is the sole hard-edged form in an otherwise diffuse frame
images.focal: The wordmark's left end, where the dark sphere sits in the O and stops the eye before it runs along the letters.
images.balance: The centre band carries the mark and the brightest bloom; the top left and bottom left fall away to unbroken colour with nothing in them.

images.composition: Straight-on square crop, frame centred and near full height, leaves entering from both lower corners.
texture: chalky speckled plaster wall
distressed flecking eating into the edges of the black strokes
matte uncoated pastel fields
waxy leaf blades throwing back a low sheen
fine straight-grained pale moulding
contrast: black letterforms cutting across pastel fields
a pink half-field meeting sky blue on a hard vertical seam
the dot fill in the upper bowl repeated at four times the size in the bottom bowl
the leaf silhouettes at left rhyme with the poster's black shapes in weight and edge
stripe fills running at three separate angles inside one sheet
images.focal: The black stem of the B down the centre right, which holds the eye through the stacked bowls of dots and checks hung off it.
images.balance: The middle of the sheet is crowded corner to corner; the mat border and the upper right wall are empty, and the foliage packs the lower left outside the frame.

subjects: horizon band of stacked colour bars
images.composition: Frontal and slightly above centre, three panels evenly spaced, the outer two cropped.
texture: chalky flat-painted wall
posterised print grain that breaks the foliage into loose speckle
smooth rounded frame lips catching a thin highlight
soft-edged cast shadow with no defined boundary
contrast: the same image run three times over three different paper grounds, which sets the rhythm of the whole frame
a raking diagonal shadow dims the left panel while the middle sits fully lit
crimson and chartreuse recur in every panel at identical size and position
warm print against a cool green wall
images.focal: The middle blush panel, the only one entirely inside the frame, and its crimson tree holds the eye.
images.balance: All three prints sit on one horizontal band across the middle; the wall above and below them is unbroken, and the flanking panels are cut by the frame edges.

subjects: horizon band of stacked colour bars
images.composition: Frontal, three evenly spaced panels, outer two cut by the frame edges.
texture: chalky flat-painted wall carrying a faint tonal drift
posterised speckle breaking the canopy into loose grain
smooth rounded frame lips with a thin top highlight
diffuse shadow edges that never resolve to a line
contrast: one artwork printed on three grounds, dark sage then butter then near-white, stepping lighter left to right
the blush wall and the pale right-hand print sit within a shade of each other
the crimson trunk repeats in all three panels at the same weight against grounds of very different value
a soft diagonal shadow crosses the left third while the middle panel stays open
images.focal: The butter yellow middle panel, the brightest field in the frame, with the crimson tree at its centre.
images.balance: Everything happens on one horizontal band through the middle; wall runs empty across the top and along the bottom.

images.composition: Straight-on and symmetrical, two portrait frames of equal size side by side with an even gap.
texture: dense photographic grain that thickens as the sky darkens
woven canvas tooth visible under the dark right-hand print
flat brushed frame faces with a fine linear sheen
diffuse branch shadow drifting over the plaster wall
contrast: a pale washed-out left sheet against a near-black right sheet
the rainbow arc on the left and the dot rows on the right both curve, one continuous, one broken into units
the two prints share the same rose and amber cast despite the difference in value
a thin pink rule running the right edge of the dark sheet, the only clean line in either
images.focal: The dot matrix block on the right poster, which pulls first and holds because the dots resolve into letter shapes the longer they are read.
images.balance: Both sheets carry their incident low, the skyline and the wordmark near the bottom edge; the upper halves are open sky and open dark, and the wall between and around them is bare.

subjects: right triangle formed by the band ends
text: they're coming near hold on now
images.composition: Overhead vantage on a frame lying flat and slightly rotated, the stepped stripe block dominating the lower half.
texture: fine woven tooth running through the print, visible in every band
chalky speckled ground flecked with dark grit
matte frame walls with no reflection on the inner returns
a diffuse blue stain soaking into the surface at upper left
contrast: bands stepping from near-black at the top to near-white at the bottom in even increments
the horizontal band rhythm cut by one diagonal running corner to corner
the frame's blue-black echoes the blue wash on the ground beneath it
the type sits centred and small against a large empty upper field
images.focal: The apex of the pale triangle at the right, where the widest white band meets the diagonal and the steps begin.
images.balance: The lower left two thirds carry all the striping; the top third and the right column hold flat unbroken dark, and the type is the only mark in the upper half.

text: Rockin' My Cutlass With Them Suicide Doors
images.composition: Straight-on wall elevation, portrait frame set just left of centre, the burst filling the sheet edge to edge.
texture: chalky matte ink sitting flat in the sheet
woven paper tooth ruled with fine horizontal lines across every wedge
sanded pale frame moulding
printed dots level with the paper, no relief
contrast: hard-edged wedge geometry against the soft blurred shadow drifting down the wall behind the frame
every wedge is knocked back to the same dusty saturation, so pattern rather than hue separates one from the next
the dot rhythm on the upper coral wedge repeats at a larger beat in the mint block below it
the yellows at upper left return in the lower right, carrying the same value across the pivot
images.focal: The convergence node just above centre where every wedge narrows to a point, and the eye runs outward along the widest yellow spoke.
images.balance: Pattern crowds the lower-left quadrant and the dotted mint block at right; the frame margin and the surrounding wall carry no incident.

subjects: leaf shadows raking across the wall
images.composition: Straight-on, two portrait sheets side by side at equal height, the right one tipped a few degrees off plane.
texture: chalky uncoated stock with softened, chewed edges
grainy emulsion speckle over both images
flat plaster wall taking the shadow with no sheen
waxy dark water holding the reflection unbroken
contrast: the mirrored horizon splits each sheet into a lit half above and a submerged half below
both sheets run the same layout, so the gold treeline on the left sits at the same height as the red one on the right
the room's teal wall repeats the teal already in the left sheet's sky
warm foliage against cool sky in both prints
images.focal: The gold canopy at the top of the left sheet, the brightest thing in frame, then across to the red treeline holding the same line on the right.
images.balance: Both sheets are weighted to their upper halves where the foliage sits; the lower thirds go dark and the wall around and between them is bare apart from shadow.

images.composition: Square frame shot straight on, motif centred and floating clear of all four edges.
texture: flat vector shapes carrying no grain at all
coarse open-grained frame timber with red-brown stain sitting down in the pores
one long soft glare band across the upper right of the glazing
smooth painted plaster around the frame
contrast: flat saturated shapes against a brown-red ground dark enough to swallow their lower edges
the frame's stain repeats the ground colour of the print it holds
curling organic ribbons at the bottom against the blocky cloud lobes above
teal appears twice, upper left and mid right, bracketing the pink core between them
images.focal: The pink and white striped wedge at the centre of the motif, held there by the teal cloud mass wrapping its left side.
images.balance: Everything happens in a horizontal band across the middle third; the top and bottom quarters are unbroken dark ground.

images.composition: Square frame straight on, motif centred and rising off the lower edge with the disc setting a horizon.
texture: heavy cold-press paper tooth reading across the whole white field
scratchy etched line with dry broken strokes
flat brushed green disc with a mottled, blotted rim
smooth matte black lacquer on the frame
soft brushed wall surface behind
contrast: fine engraved line laid over the solid flat green disc
the disc's arc is answered by the smaller scroll curl at lower right
dark brown drawing on pale paper, the green sitting between them in value
the spatter at the base breaks up the same way the tree's needle mass does
images.focal: The conifer crown breaking above the top of the green disc, then down the trunk into the tangle at the base.
images.balance: Detail collects in a thick band along the bottom third; the upper corners and the paper margin all round stay bare.

subjects: dried grass stems at the right edge
images.composition: Eye-level three-quarter view along the console, the leaning poster dominating the right of the frame.
texture: gritty flecked poster stock, its speckle visible even in the flat sky
coarse slubbed linen shade weave
chalky unglazed ceramic, sanded and slightly pitted over the belly
rift-sawn oak frame with faint straight grain
matte board book covers
waxy turned bowl catching a single highlight along its rim
contrast: the balloon envelope and the treeline share the same photographic grain, one dissolving into the other with no seam
the lamp's round ceramic belly answers the balloon's round envelope across the frame
flat sage sky against the dense stippled yellow of the field
the room's neutrals hold the left, all the saturation sits on the right
images.focal: The balloon envelope, its pale top standing off the sage field, then down the taper to the basket resting on the yellow horizon.
images.balance: The right two thirds carry the poster and the book stack; the left holds one lamp against a mostly empty wall.

images.composition: Straight-on product shot, square sleeve at left, record drawn halfway out to the right, the pair centred on flat ground.
texture: taut shrink-wrap throwing white creases across the top-left corner and again down the right edge
grooved disc pulling a soft ring of highlight along its outer band
chalky washed-out stock under the portrait, its paint edges bleeding rather than cutting
coarse printed dots stepping from solid to open across the bar
the sleeve board bowing slightly where the disc sits behind it
contrast: the flat pink backdrop and the sleeve's pink washes run so close in hue that the sleeve edge is found by its shadow, not its colour
the dead black of the record against the pale skin beside it
the dot bar under the logotype repeats smaller in the honeycomb over the hair and again on the disc label
hard-edged black logotype against the dissolving painted edges of the face
images.focal: The eyes, turned to the frame's left, held by the pale skin sitting inside the darker washes around them.
images.balance: The left half is packed with face, logotype and dot rows; the right half is plain disc and an empty spine strip.

subjects: rapeseed field at the tree's base
images.composition: Straight-on product shot, square sleeve at left, record drawn out right, both centred on a flat yellow ground.
texture: dry split woodgrain with open knots and hairline checks running vertically the full height
abraded print surface scored with pale scratch marks
grooved disc carrying one soft highlight arc across its upper left
bare cut board at the sleeve edges, no wrap film on this one
foliage broken into fine speckle by the print screen
contrast: the round photo vignette cut into a ground of straight vertical grain
the diagonal hazard stripes at the bottom repeat along the top edge, bracketing the sleeve
the yellow backdrop is the same yellow as the rapeseed field inside the sleeve
the dot column at the right and the argyle panel below it hold the same beat as the stippled canopy
images.focal: The oak crown, dark and dense against the pale blue disc of sky behind it, then down the trunk to the yellow field.
images.balance: Weight sits in the sleeve's left two thirds where the tree fills the vignette; the right third is spine, then flat disc.

subjects: large script letterform filled with a starfield
images.composition: Straight-on product shot, square sleeve left, record pulled out right, deer and letterform interlocked across the sleeve centre.
texture: taut shrink-wrap throwing thin white creases across both upper corners and one long diagonal down the middle
velvety flocked coat with the hair direction readable across the neck
chalky antler bone, dry and pitted along the beams
faint ruled graph paper printed under everything
granular spatter in the lower right
one broad soft highlight lying along the top of the disc
contrast: the photographic deer against everything flat and printed around it
the antler tines and the letterform's tail both fork upward, one on each side of the sleeve
the starfield inside the letter is the only dark mass on the sleeve and it sits directly beside the black record
the green pinstripes at the left run the same angle as the striped triangles below them
images.focal: The buck's eye and muzzle, the only photographic detail in a sleeve of flat graphics, with the large letterform pulling the eye right afterward.
images.balance: Incident crowds the left half and the lower-left corner; the sleeve's lower right and the spine strip are close to bare grid.
